items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I left to go with J.J in the latter part of 1957... We made a record recording... We went to Sweden and we went to Denmark

ctx.x: Oh I’d say almost a year. It was a long time. And I left to go with J.J in the latter part of 1957 in the summers. We went to Sweden and we went to Denmark- we were in Scandinavia. We made a record recording—before we went we made these records at Colombia Studios 32nd street: “J is for Jazz” and another album. It was really fun a lot of nice tunes on there and J.J., with his beautiful arrangements, he was a genius
So JJ called you to do a recording before your European tour? And this is your first trip overseas correct? Was that something special for you?
We went over on a boat you know-­
